free_text: The decision is to defer biopsy because the cohort criterion fired based on the PSA value of 190.0 ng/mL, which aligns with the finding that the patient already has a tissue diagnosis. The high-risk MRI finding, specifically the PI-RADS 5 lesion size of 28 x 22 x 20 mm, supports the cohort criterion that prioritizes staging and treatment over further tissue sampling.
